opening.argument: The description directly invites viewers to sign up and invest in HashFlare Mining and Genisis Mining, and provides a BitConnect signup-and-invest link containing a referral parameter. These are concrete pathways to participate in paid mining or node-return services, including referral participation. Although the spoken material presents a GDAX tutorial, the description separately promotes these investment links. The available video evidence does not establish that the named services were demonstrated on-screen, or that any promised return, transaction, loss, or external-service outcome occurred. The case rests on the direct signup-and-invest invitations and referral link, not on an asserted result.
